name: measured_camera
_comment: measured.json with the sensing range replaced by what this repository's own
perception stack actually delivers. The 0.004-0.010 m in measured.json comes
from published YCB-Video results and holds for a fixed camera with no
clutter (0.0065 m measured). A wrist camera with three distractors -- the
realistic case -- gives 0.0513 m overall and 0.0778 m on the hard frames,
five to thirteen times worse. Every transfer number in this repository was
produced under sensing better than its own estimator provides; this level
exists so that gap can be trained against rather than only noted.
